## Checklist

- [ ] Docs updated where behavior, settings or commands changed.
- [ ] User-visible text is US English.
- [ ] Migrations: none / added and reversible / added and one-way (say why below).
- [ ] No breaking change to a public setting, API field, import path or overridable template; or it is deprecated first, as in [docs/upgrading.md](../docs/upgrading.md).
- [ ] No secrets, real customer data or company-specific names in code, fixtures or docs.
